tha-ap119:1.1: vipassī → vipassi (sya-all) | vipassī lokaggo āyusaṅkhāramossaji pathavī → vipassilokaggo āyusaṅkhāram ossaji paṭhavī (pts)
tha-ap119:1.3: pathavī → paṭhavī (bj, sya-all) | sampakampittha → S1 yaṁ pakampittha. (pts note)
tha-ap119:1.4: medanī → medinī (bj) | medanī jalamekhalā otataṁ vitthataṁ → medanījalamekhalā ogataṁ vitataṁ (sya-all) | medanī jalamekhalā → medinījalamekhalā (pts)
tha-ap119:2.1: vitthataṁ → vittaṁ (bj: sī.selu, PTS) | vitthataṁ → otataṁ vitataṁ (cck: syā.)
tha-ap119:2.2: suvicittavaṭaṁsakaṁ bhavanampi → suci cittaṁ papañcakaṁ bhavanaṁpi (sya-all); suvicittaṁ vaṭaṁsakaṁ bhavanam pi (pts) | suvicittavaṭaṁsakaṁ → suvicittaṁ (bj: PTS, sī.selu) | suvicittavaṭaṁsakaṁ → sucicittaṁ papañcakaṁ (cck: syā.) | vaṭaṁsakaṁ → S1 vaṭāsakaṁ. (pts note)
tha-ap119:3.3: uppādo → uppāto (bj) | uppāto → uppādo (bj: sabbattha) | Uppādo → uppāto (cck: ?)
tha-ap119:4.3: pāṇabhūte → pāṇabhute (bj); pāṇabhūtaṁ (sya-all, pts) | pāṇabhute → pāṇabhutaṁ (bj: PTS, sī.selu) | Pāṇabhūte → pāṇabhutaṁ (cck: syā.); pāṇabhūnaṁ (cck: sī. ka.) | bhayaṁ → G. tayaṁ. (pts note)
tha-ap119:4.4: saṁvutā → sagāravā (sya-all) | saṁvutā → sagāravā (cck: syā.) | hotha → S1 bhota. (pts note)
tha-ap119:5.1: buddhā → buddho (bj, cck, sya-all) | dhammā → dhammo (cck, sya-all) | dhammā → dhammo (bj: itipi)
tha-ap119:5.3: uppajjamānamhi pathavī → uppajjamānasmiṁ paṭhavī (sya-all, pts) | yasmiṁ → G. yamhi. (pts note)
tha-ap119:5.4: pathavī → paṭhavī (cck: sī. syā.) | paṭhavī → S2 paṭhaviṁ. (pts note)
tha-ap119:6.4: caritaṁ → karitaṁ (sya-all) | caritaṁ → kāritaṁ (bj: PTS, sī.selu); karitaṁ (bj: sīmu) | caritaṁ → karitaṁ (cck: sī. syā.); kāritaṁ (cck: ka.)
